faq.question: Do you guarantee specific lead volumes or revenue results?
faq.answer: No honest agency can guarantee exact revenue figures because market dynamics, your pricing, and your internal sales closing rates vary. However, we audit every variable upfront, build proven funnel architectures, test rigorously, and set realistic benchmarks so you have full visibility before launching.

faq.question: How quickly will our campaigns and website go live?
faq.answer: Our average turnaround from discovery kickoff to active campaigns is 21 business days. This includes market research, custom landing page copy & design, video creative production, pixel attribution configuration, and final quality assurance.

faq.question: Can you revamp or improve our existing website instead of starting from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. During our discovery audit, we review your current site speed, mobile usability, and conversion rate. If your current foundation is solid, we can optimize existing pages and add conversion elements. If the codebase is slow and costing you ad revenue, we will show you the exact data and recommend an upgrade.

faq.question: How does the WhatsApp AI Concierge work?
faq.answer: We train an automated conversational agent on your business services, pricing, availability, and FAQs. It is connected directly to your official WhatsApp Business API, answering leads within seconds 24/7, qualifying their requirements, and passing warm, ready-to-close appointments to your team.

faq.question: How will we communicate and track ongoing progress?
faq.answer: You receive a dedicated private WhatsApp channel and direct access to your Growth Director. Furthermore, you get a 24/7 live Looker Studio dashboard tracking spend, leads, CAC, and conversions in real time, supplemented with scheduled strategy reviews.
